release_notes: **Fibonacci pivot strike selector** (Strategy Composer): picks a strike at the R1–R3 or S1–S3 Fibonacci pivot from the previous day's or week's high/low/close, rounded outward. The strategy skips entry if the price data is missing or stale, or if spot has already moved past the level. **Weekday filter**: allow entry only on one chosen day of the week. **Premium decay exit**: closes the position once every sold option leg is priced at or below a set value (default ₹0.05, i.e. almost all premium gone). Treated as a profit-taking exit, so the same live-price checks apply. **Dashboard Table view ⋮ menu**: each table row now has the same ⋮ menu as the card (Config, Edit in Composer, Clone, Archive, Delete). **Export Excel** on the run-log window: downloads the run as a `.xlsx` with an **Events** sheet (one row per event, every leg/price field as its own filterable column) and a **Log** sheet with the raw lines. macOS downloads now include a `.pkg` installer, which always installs to /Applications. The zip stays available as the no-installer option. **Upstox** backtests on past dates now fetch candles for expired option contracts through Upstox's expired-instruments API (requires Upstox Plus). Expired futures are not covered yet.
